result.summary: Found 1 issue: the Orders tab in the bottom navigation is missing its icon, breaking visual consistency with the other tabs.

issues.description: In the bottom navigation bar, the 'Orders' tab shows only its text label with an empty space where its icon should be, while Home, Search, and Profile all display an icon above their label.
issues.suggestion: Render the missing Orders icon above its label so every bottom navigation tab has a consistent icon-and-label pair.
